cities.name: Timișoara
cities.local_food_tip: Try Banat vegetable stews, soups, pastries and mild regional dishes — comforting and widely vegetarian-friendly.
cities.full_day: Morning: Start at Union Square with pastel façades glowing in soft light → Step inside St. George’s Cathedral → Explore the Baroque Palace exterior → Grab a cozy break at Librarium Café. Afternoon: Walk Victory Square, fountains and historic boulevards → See the Romanian Opera House exterior → Relax in Roses Park and enjoy a Banat-style lunch. Sunset: Catch warm light on the Bega River promenade. Night: Enjoy dessert spots and calm riverside evening walks.

ideas: Evening promenades to escape the heat.
Gelato stops in the Old Town.

public_transport_tips: Trams connect most central areas easily.
The Old Town is fully walkable.
Buses reach parks and river promenades.
Ride apps are cheap for longer distances.

cities.name: Alba Iulia
cities.local_food_tip: Taste Transylvanian soups, dumplings, pastries and gentle, warm regional dishes.
cities.full_day: Morning: Explore the star-shaped Alba Carolina Fortress → Visit Union Hall → See reconstructed Roman gates → Take a relaxing break in a fortress courtyard café. Afternoon: Visit the Coronation Cathedral → National Museum of the Union → Enjoy a Transylvanian lunch. Sunset: Walk the fortress bastions glowing in golden hour. Night: Explore illuminated fortress alleys and dessert cafés.
public_transport_tips: Most attractions are inside the citadel and walkable.
Local buses connect outer districts.
Taxis are inexpensive for quick transfers.
Bike rentals help explore fortification paths.

cities.name: Cluj-Napoca
cities.local_food_tip: Try Transylvanian soups, pastries, sarmale, pasta dishes and student-friendly vegetarian meals.
cities.full_day: Morning: Explore Unirii Square → Visit St. Michael’s Church → See the Matthias Corvinus statue → Enjoy a coffee in a student-friendly café. Afternoon: Wander Old Town streets and bookstores → Visit the National Museum of Transylvanian History → Spend relaxing hours in the Botanical Garden → Enjoy a traditional Transylvanian lunch. Sunset: Catch golden views from Cetățuia Hill. Night: Explore dessert cafés and lit-up student districts.

ideas: Cool breezes near Cluj Arena paths.

public_transport_tips: Buses and trams cover all central areas.
Walking is ideal for Old Town exploration.
Cluj Card offers discounted rides and museum entries.
Ride apps are common and safe.

city_events.name: Cluj Days Festival
city_events.description: Concerts, outdoor shows and cultural activities.

city_events.name: Christmas Fair
city_events.description: Holiday lights, stalls and family-friendly events.

cities.name: Sibiu
cities.local_food_tip: Enjoy Transylvanian dumplings, soups, pastries, stews and vegetarian-friendly dishes.
cities.full_day: Morning: Begin in Piața Mare → Explore Brukenthal Palace exterior → Climb or view the Council Tower → Relax in a café in Piața Mică. Afternoon: Walk the Bridge of Lies → Visit the History Museum exterior → Stroll Sub Arini Park → Enjoy a warm Transylvanian lunch. Sunset: Explore citadel walls glowing at golden hour. Night: Enjoy dessert cafés and peaceful illuminated streets.
public_transport_tips: Old Town is fully walkable.
Buses connect parks and outer areas.
City bike rentals are widely available.
Taxi apps work well for longer routes.

city_events.name: Sibiu Theatre Festival
city_events.description: One of Romania’s biggest cultural events with performances across the city.

city_events.name: Sibiu Christmas Market
city_events.description: Famous festive fair with lights, stalls and winter treats.

cities.name: Brașov
cities.local_food_tip: Try Transylvanian soups, pastries, goulash-style stews and mild vegetarian-friendly dishes.
cities.full_day: Morning: Explore Council Square → Visit the Black Church exterior → Walk through Rope Street → Take a calm coffee break in the Old Town. Afternoon: Ride the Tampa cable car → Explore medieval bastions and shady walls → Enjoy a Transylvanian lunch. Sunset: Watch golden light from Tampa Viewpoint. Night: Stroll old-town streets with dessert stops and warm lights.

ideas: Outdoor terraces in the Old Town.
Cool forest paths on Tampa Mountain.
Refreshing gelato in the Old Town.
Museum afternoons in the Old Town.

public_transport_tips: Cable car is the fastest way to Tampa viewpoint.
Old Town is fully walkable.
Buses connect nearby districts.
Taxis and ride apps work well for mountain bases.

city_events.name: Brașov Summer Nights
city_events.description: Street shows, outdoor performances and lively evening vibes.

city_events.name: Brașov Christmas Fair
city_events.description: Lights, stalls and festive concerts in the old town.

cities.name: Oradea
cities.local_food_tip: Enjoy Bihor soups, dumplings, pastries and vegetarian-friendly regional dishes.
cities.full_day: Morning: Explore Union Square with pastel Art Nouveau façades → Walk through the Black Eagle Palace passage → Visit the Moon Church. Afternoon: Tour Oradea Fortress → Stroll Crișul Repede riverside paths → Enjoy a traditional Bihor lunch. Sunset: Catch city lights from a rooftop viewpoint. Night: Dessert cafés along the river with calm evening atmosphere.

ideas: Art Nouveau façades with spring flowers.
Evening cool breezes by the river.

public_transport_tips: Trams cover the city center well.
Walking is ideal for Old Town.
Buses link the fortress and river areas.
Ride apps are fast and reliable.

city_events.name: Oradea Festive Fair
city_events.description: Holiday lights, art stalls and winter snacks.

city_events.name: Art Nouveau Days
city_events.description: A celebration of architecture, galleries and street art.

cities.name: Iași
cities.local_food_tip: Taste Moldavian soups, sarmale, pastries, stews and plenty of vegetarian options.
cities.full_day: Morning: Visit the Palace of Culture exterior → See the Metropolitan Cathedral → Walk Union Square → Coffee break in a central student café. Afternoon: Relax in Copou Park → Visit Eminescu’s Linden Tree → Explore the Botanical Garden → Enjoy a Moldavian lunch. Sunset: Enjoy golden views from Copou Hill. Night: Dessert cafés and warm student-district evening walks.

ideas: Outdoor terraces full of student life.

public_transport_tips: Trams and buses connect all central landmarks.
Copou Hill is best reached by bus or taxi.
Botanical Garden requires a short ride from center.
Old Town is fully walkable.

cities.name: Bucharest
cities.local_food_tip: Try Romanian soups, sarmale, pastries and vegetarian-friendly modern meals across the city.
cities.full_day: Morning: Explore the Old Town → Admire the Romanian Athenaeum exterior → Visit University Square → Relax in a central café. Afternoon: Walk Cișmigiu Park → Explore Herăstrău Lake area → Visit art or history museums → Enjoy a Romanian lunch. Sunset: Lakeside golden reflections at Herăstrău. Night: Dessert cafés and illuminated old-town streets.
public_transport_tips: Metro is the fastest way around the city.
Old Town is walkable but crowded.
Buses reach parks and lakes easily.
Taxi apps are widely used and safe.

city_events.name: Bucharest Christmas Market
city_events.description: Huge festive fair with lights and seasonal food.

cities.name: Constanța
cities.local_food_tip: Enjoy coastal soups, grilled vegetables, pastries and seaside vegetarian options.
cities.full_day: Morning: Visit the Casino promenade → Walk sea cliffs by the waterfront → Explore the Roman Mosaic site → Enjoy a seafront café break. Afternoon: Visit the Archaeology Museum → Explore Ovid Square → Walk Mamaia Beach → Have a coastal lunch. Sunset: Watch waves glow at the Casino waterfront. Night: Ice cream and seaside dessert cafés with peaceful night air.

ideas: Outdoor cafés reopening for the season.

public_transport_tips: Buses connect downtown with Mamaia easily.
Promenade is best explored on foot.
Taxis help reach remote seaside areas.
Walking is ideal for the historic center.

city_events.name: Constanța Days
city_events.description: Concerts, celebrations and lively seaside atmosphere.

city_events.name: Winter Seaside Lights
city_events.description: Festive decorations across Ovid Square and promenade.
